paragraphs: Cork University Hospital is the second biggest hospital in Ireland. Its doctors and managers are worried. They say there are not enough staff. They think this could be a danger for patients.
The Government and the HSE do not agree. The HSE runs health services in Ireland.
Early next week, the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, will meet the hospital's boss and other managers. The Health Minister, Jennifer Carroll MacNeill, will also meet them next week.
The minister says the hospital is safe. She says there are no more deaths than before. A new report on the hospital will come out in the next few weeks.
sentZh: 科克大學醫院是愛爾蘭第二大醫院。
院內的醫師和管理人員很擔心。
他們說人手不夠。
他們認為這可能對病人造成危險。
政府和HSE並不同意。
HSE負責管理愛爾蘭的醫療服務。
下週初，總理Micheál Martin將會見醫院院長和其他管理人員。
衛生部長Jennifer Carroll MacNeill下週也會和他們見面。
部長說這家醫院是安全的。
她說死亡人數沒有比以前多。
一份關於該醫院的新報告將在未來幾週發布。

paragraphs: Taoiseach Micheál Martin and Health Minister Jennifer Carroll MacNeill will meet managers and senior doctors from Cork University Hospital early next week. The hospital is the second largest in the country.

There is a disagreement about the hospital. Local managers and doctors say there are not enough staff, and rules that stop new hiring could put patients at risk. The Government and leaders of the HSE do not agree.

Andy Phillips, who runs HSE services in the south-west, is under pressure. A recording of a heated meeting came out. In it, he seemed to say that the Government had told him to have serious talks with the hospital's chief executive, Jennifer Kearney, after she spoke about safety. He later said sorry and said he had received no such orders.
The head of the HSE, Anne O'Connor, was criticised this week because she had not spoken to Ms Kearney for several weeks. She will visit Cork on Monday.
